implemented_requirements.requirement: Daily puzzle generation (different puzzle each calendar day)
implemented_requirements.evidence: puzzles.js defines PUZZLES array, getDailyPuzzle(date) and getPuzzleNumber(date) that compute a puzzle based on days since a fixed epoch.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Presentation of a 4x4 grid of 16 words
implemented_requirements.evidence: index.html contains an empty <section id="grid"> placeholder, but game.js excerpt does not show any code that populates the grid with words.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player can select exactly four words at a time
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.js declares a Set called selected and a submit button, but no event‑handler code for tile selection or enforcement of a four‑word limit is visible.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Correct groups are removed and revealed with category name and difficulty colour (yellow, green, blue, purple)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Constants DIFFICULTY_COLORS and DOM refs for solved groups exist, yet there is no visible logic that removes tiles, displays the category, or applies the colour.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Incorrect guesses count as mistakes, maximum of four allowed
implemented_requirements.evidence: MAX_MISTAKES constant is defined, but no code that increments a mistake counter, updates the UI, or ends the game after four errors is present.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Only one correct solution exists (even though words may appear to fit multiple categories)
implemented_requirements.evidence: puzzles.js validates each puzzle to have exactly four categories, each with four unique words, implying a single intended grouping.
A shuffle button (shuffleBtn) is referenced in game.js, but the implementation of the shuffle algorithm is not shown.
messageEl and gameOverEl elements exist for feedback, yet no code that writes messages after a submit is visible.

critical_issues: Core game logic (rendering the 16 words, handling tile selection, enforcing group size, submitting guesses) is missing from the provided code.
No implementation of shuffle, mistake tracking, or win/lose state transitions is evident.
Without the missing sections, the application cannot be executed as a functional puzzle game.
The placeholder "..." in game.js prevents verification that required behaviours are actually coded.
judge.summary: The repository includes a solid skeleton for daily puzzle selection and UI markup, but the essential gameplay mechanics—grid population, word selection, guess validation, mistake handling, shuffle, and feedback—are not present in the visible code. Consequently, the solution does not meet the core functional requirements and cannot be considered a complete, executable implementation.
